mapper.sql: revision_id AS "revisionId" , project_id AS "projectId" , revision_label AS "revisionLabel" , status AS "status" , analyzer_version AS "analyzerVersion" , to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM analysis_revision WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY revision_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_revision (project_id, revision_label, status, analyzer_version) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{revisionLabel}, 'CREATED', #{analyzerVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_revision SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE status = 'ANALYZING'
mapper.select: SELECT pass AS "pass" , status AS "status" , analysis_id AS "analysisId" , total_count AS "totalCount" , done_count AS "doneCount" , to_char(started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "startedAt" , to_char(ended_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "endedAt" FROM analysis_revision_pass WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY started_at, pass
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_revision_pass (revision_id, pass, status, analysis_id, started_at) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{pass}, 'RUNNING', #{analysisId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (revision_id, pass) DO UPDATE SET status = 'RUNNING' , analysis_id = EXCLUDED.analysis_id , started_at = now() , ended_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_revision_pass SET status = 'FAILED' , ended_at = now() WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analysis_metric WHERE analysis_id IN (SELECT analysis_id FROM analysis_job WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId})
